mapper.select: SELECT p.participant_id AS participantId,p.campaign_id AS campaignId,p.organization_id AS organizationId,p.shop_id AS shopId,p.definition_id AS definitionId, p.definition_version AS definitionVersion,p.generation,p.state,p.created_at AS createdAt,g.valid_count AS validCount,g.ever_qualified_count AS everQualifiedCount,g.progress_revision AS progressRevision FROM mk_referral_participant p LEFT JOIN mk_referral_progress g ON g.tenant_id=p.tenant_id AND g.participant_id=p.participant_id WHERE AND p.participant_id>#{after} ORDER BY p.participant_id LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT r.relation_id AS relationId,r.participant_id AS participantId,r.bound_at AS boundAt,r.deadline_at AS deadlineAt,r.state,q.state AS qualificationState,q.reason, q.counted,q.ever_qualified AS everQualified,q.qualification_revision AS qualificationRevision,q.evidence_state_version AS evidenceVersion FROM mk_referral_relation r JOIN mk_referral_participant p ON p.tenant_id=r.tenant_id AND p.participant_id=r.participant_id LEFT JOIN mk_referral_qualification q ON q.tenant_id=r.tenant_id AND q.relation_id=r.relation_id WHERE AND r.tenant_id=#{tenant} AND r.campaign_id=#{campaign} AND r.relation_id>#{after} ORDER BY r.relation_id LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT r.reward_id AS rewardId,r.participant_id AS participantId,r.relation_id AS relationId,r.role,r.mode,r.rule_id AS ruleId,r.threshold_count AS threshold, r.entitlement_state AS entitlementState,r.authorization_state AS authorizationState,r.risk_state AS riskState,r.delivery_state AS deliveryState,r.compensation_state AS compensationState, r.quota_state AS quotaState,r.row_version AS revision,r.created_at AS createdAt FROM mk_referral_reward r JOIN mk_referral_participant p ON p.tenant_id=r.tenant_id AND p.participant_id=r.participant_id WHERE AND r.tenant_id=#{tenant} AND r.campaign_id=#{campaign} AND r.reward_id>#{after} ORDER BY r.reward_id LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT a.participants,b.relations,b.projectedValidRelations,b.everQualifiedRelations,b.awaitingEvaluation, c.rewards,c.succeededRewards,c.invalidatedRewards,c.pendingCompensation,c.reversedRewards,c.manualReviewRewards FROM (SELECT COUNT(*) AS participants FROM mk_referral_participant p WHERE ) a CROSS JOIN (SELECT COUNT(*) AS relations,COALESCE(SUM(q.counted=TRUE),0) AS projectedValidRelations,COALESCE(SUM(q.ever_qualified=TRUE),0) AS everQualifiedRelations, COALESCE(SUM(q.relation_id IS NULL OR t.relation_id IS NULL OR t.status<>'DONE' OR t.requested_revision<>t.processed_revision),0) AS awaitingEvaluation FROM mk_referral_relation r JOIN mk_referral_participant p ON p.tenant_id=r.tenant_id AND p.participant_id=r.participant_id LEFT JOIN mk_referral_qualification q ON q.tenant_id=r.tenant_id AND q.relation_id=r.relation_id LEFT JOIN mk_referral_evaluation_task t ON t.tenant_id=r.tenant_id AND t.relation_id=r.relation_id WHERE AND r.tenant_id=#{tenant} AND r.campaign_id=#{campaign}) b CROSS JOIN (SELECT COUNT(*) AS rewards,COALESCE(SUM(r.delivery_state='SUCCEEDED'),0) AS succeededRewards, COALESCE(SUM(r.entitlement_state='INVALIDATED'),0) AS invalidatedRewards,COALESCE(SUM(r.compensation_state='PENDING'),0) AS pendingCompensation, COALESCE(SUM(r.compensation_state='REVERSED'),0) AS reversedRewards,COALESCE(SUM(r.compensation_state='MANUAL_REVIEW'),0) AS manualReviewRewards FROM mk_referral_reward r JOIN mk_referral_participant p ON p.tenant_id=r.tenant_id AND p.participant_id=r.participant_id WHERE AND r.tenant_id=#{tenant} AND r.campaign_id=#{campaign}) c
